title: B R Ambedkar Hall of Residence
text:
B. R. Ambedkar Hall of Residence is one among the twenty halls in IIT Kharagpur. It has been operational since July 2014. It is the second largest hall in IIT Kharagpur with capacity of 1540 students. Majority of the students resides here are Research Scholars(RS). It was one of a kind, co-ed hall with one wing solely allocated to girls until May 2017. After reallocation of girls, new UG/PG & PGDBM students are allocated to BRH. It is a massive and grand hall with beautiful internal as well as external architecture.

Location
Situated near super duper. One can reach by taking the straight road beside the north of B C Roy Technology Hospital & behind the Azad Hall of Residence. 

Wardens
Prof. Mangal Roy, Associate Professor (Metallurgical And Materials Engineering Dept.)

Prof. Manoj Kumar Tiwari, Assistant Professor (School Of Water Resources)

Prof. Ayan Roy Chaudhuri Assistant Professor Grade-I (Materials Science Centre)

Prof. Ram Babu Roy Assistant Professor Grade-I (Rajendra Mishra School Of Engg Entrepreneurship)

Prof. Mahendra Reddy Vanteru Assistant Professor Grade-I (Mechanical Engineering)
